title: Theory Playalong Sidecar
summary: Play notes against a chosen key while your backing track keeps moving.
user: Beginning instrumentalists using a MIDI keyboard who want to see harmony and try ideas while a score or backing track continues playing.
smallest_useful_product: Browser MIDI input plus local audio-file playback, a one-octave note/chord map, beat marker, and non-judgmental in-key/out-of-key history.
success_measure: 30% of users connect MIDI and complete three five-minute playalong sessions in their first week.
